text.tspan: Smart Extraction is a platform I designed for a team of lawyers in
the United States who needed an AI-integrated tool capable of
extracting predefined information from hundreds of contracts in
seconds. The system organizes the extracted data into charts and
tables for fast and efficient comparison.
It was a fascinating project that allowed me to explore how
emerging technologies like AI can be effectively integrated into
traditional industries. I learned a lot about designing for complex
data systems and creating intuitive interfaces for professional
